overview.description: The TCW AAA CLO ETF (ACLO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund seeks to preserve capital and provide current income by actively investing in AAA-rated USD-denominated CLOs of any maturity. ACLO was launched on Nov 15, 2024 and is issued by TCW.
